# Goal

This notebook trains **three models** (LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest) on a
temporal sample (`SAMPLE=80_000` rows), registers each in the MLflow Model
Registry, and verifies that everything appears correctly on DagsHub.

> **Note:** For full-data training, use `make train model.name=lightgbm`,
> `make train model.name=xgboost`, or `make train model.name=random_forest`.
> This notebook uses a sample for fast verification of the end-to-end flow.

**What we verify:**

1. Each model trains successfully with temporal split
2. Each model is logged to MLflow (params, metrics, artifacts, model)
3. Each model is registered in the Model Registry with a unique name
4. The champion/challenger flow works across models
5. Results are visible on DagsHub

# 1. Setup

```{python}
import logging
import os
import time
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from fdml.utils.logging import ensure_logging
from fdml.utils.paths import PROJECT_ROOT

os.chdir(PROJECT_ROOT)
ensure_logging()

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=UserWarning)
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)

print("Setup complete")
print(f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}")
```

# 2. Load full data

```{python}
from fdml.features.factory import load_data, load_data_config, merge_tables

data_cfg = load_data_config()
train_df, identity_df = load_data(data_cfg)
df = merge_tables(train_df, identity_df)

# Temporal sample for quick verification (full data via `make train`)
SAMPLE = 80_000
df = df.sort_values("TransactionDT").head(SAMPLE).reset_index(drop=True)

X = df.drop(columns=["isFraud"])
y = df["isFraud"]

print(f"Sample: {len(df):,} rows × {df.shape[1]} cols")
print(f"Fraud rate: {y.mean():.4%}")
print(f"Time range: [{df.TransactionDT.min():,}, {df.TransactionDT.max():,}]")
```

# 3. Temporal split

```{python}
from fdml.models.split import TemporalSplitter

splitter = TemporalSplitter(test_size=0.2, embargo_seconds=172800)
tr_idx, va_idx = next(splitter.split(df, y))

X_train, X_val = X.iloc[tr_idx], X.iloc[va_idx]
y_train, y_val = y.iloc[tr_idx], y.iloc[va_idx]

train_tr = (int(X_train.TransactionDT.min()), int(X_train.TransactionDT.max()))
val_tr = (int(X_val.TransactionDT.min()), int(X_val.TransactionDT.max()))
gap = val_tr[0] - train_tr[1]

print(f"Train: {len(X_train):,} rows  fraud={y_train.mean():.2%}  time=[{train_tr[0]:,}, {train_tr[1]:,}]")
print(f"Val:   {len(X_val):,} rows  fraud={y_val.mean():.2%}  time=[{val_tr[0]:,}, {val_tr[1]:,}]")
print(f"Gap:   {gap:,}s = {gap/86400:.1f} days")
```

# 4. Feature engineering

```{python}
from fdml.features.factory import create_pipeline, load_fe_config

features_cfg = load_fe_config()
pipeline, feature_columns = create_pipeline(features_cfg)

t0 = time.time()
X_train_fe = pipeline.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_fe = pipeline.transform(X_val)
fe_time = time.time() - t0

feature_names = list(X_train_fe.columns)
print(f"FE output: train={X_train_fe.shape}, val={X_val_fe.shape}")
print(f"FE time: {fe_time:.1f}s")
print(f"Features: {len(feature_names)}")
```

# 5. Train all three models

We train each model using the same `model_builder_registry` infrastructure that
`runner.main()` uses. Each model gets its own MLflow run with full tracking.

## 5.1 LightGBM

```{python}
import lightgbm as lgb
from fdml.models.train.model_builder import model_builder_registry
from fdml.models.train.runner import _fit_model

# Load config for LightGBM
from fdml.models.config import load_train_config

cfg_lgbm = load_train_config(cli_args=["model.name=lightgbm"])
params_lgbm = cfg_lgbm.model.params.model_dump()

builder_lgbm = model_builder_registry.get("lightgbm")
model_lgbm = builder_lgbm.build(params_lgbm)

print(f"LightGBM params: {builder_lgbm.format_params(params_lgbm)}")

t0 = time.time()
model_lgbm = _fit_model(
    model_lgbm, X_train_fe, y_train, X_val_fe, y_val, cfg_lgbm, callbacks=None
)
train_time_lgbm = time.time() - t0
print(f"LightGBM trained in {train_time_lgbm:.1f}s, best_iter={getattr(model_lgbm, 'best_iteration_', 'N/A')}")
```

## 5.2 XGBoost

```{python}
import xgboost as xgb

cfg_xgb = load_train_config(cli_args=["model.name=xgboost"])
params_xgb = cfg_xgb.model.params.model_dump()

builder_xgb = model_builder_registry.get("xgboost")
model_xgb = builder_xgb.build(params_xgb)

print(f"XGBoost params: {builder_xgb.format_params(params_xgb)}")

t0 = time.time()
model_xgb = _fit_model(
    model_xgb, X_train_fe, y_train, X_val_fe, y_val, cfg_xgb, callbacks=None
)
train_time_xgb = time.time() - t0
print(f"XGBoost trained in {train_time_xgb:.1f}s, best_iter={getattr(model_xgb, 'best_iteration_', 'N/A')}")
```

## 5.3 Random Forest

```{python}
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

cfg_rf = load_train_config(cli_args=["model.name=random_forest"])
params_rf = cfg_rf.model.params.model_dump()

builder_rf = model_builder_registry.get("random_forest")
model_rf = builder_rf.build(params_rf)

print(f"RF params: {builder_rf.format_params(params_rf)}")

t0 = time.time()
model_rf = _fit_model(
    model_rf, X_train_fe, y_train, X_val_fe, y_val, cfg_rf, callbacks=None
)
train_time_rf = time.time() - t0
print(f"Random Forest trained in {train_time_rf:.1f}s")
```

# 6. Evaluate all three

```{python}
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, average_precision_score, f1_score

models = {
    "lightgbm": model_lgbm,
    "xgboost": model_xgb,
    "random_forest": model_rf,
}

results = []
for name, model in models.items():
    y_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val_fe)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_proba)
    ap = average_precision_score(y_val, y_proba)
    f1 = f1_score(y_val, (y_proba >= 0.5).astype(int))
    results.append({
        "model": name,
        "auc": auc,
        "ap": ap,
        "f1": f1,
        "train_time_s": {"lightgbm": train_time_lgbm, "xgboost": train_time_xgb, "random_forest": train_time_rf}[name],
    })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values("auc", ascending=False)
print(results_df.to_string(index=False))
```

# 7. Register in MLflow

Now we log each model to DagsHub and register it in the Model Registry.

```{python}
import mlflow
from mlflow.models import infer_signature
from fdml.config import load_mlflow_config, resolve_mlflow_tracking

mlflow_cfg = load_mlflow_config()
resolve_mlflow_tracking(mlflow_cfg)

client = mlflow.MlflowClient()
experiment = mlflow.set_experiment(mlflow_cfg.tracking.experiment_name)

print(f"Experiment: {experiment.name} (id={experiment.experiment_id})")
print(f"Tracking URI: {mlflow.get_tracking_uri()}")
```

## 7.1 Log LightGBM

```{python}
RUN_NAME_LGBM = "lgbm_full_comparison"

with mlflow.start_run(run_name=RUN_NAME_LGBM) as run:
    # Log params
    mlflow.log_params({f"model.{k}": v for k, v in params_lgbm.items()})
    mlflow.log_param("model_name", "lightgbm")
    mlflow.log_param("train_rows", len(X_train))
    mlflow.log_param("val_rows", len(X_val))
    mlflow.log_param("n_features", len(feature_names))
    mlflow.log_param("split_strategy", "temporal")
    mlflow.log_param("seed", 42)

    # Log metrics
    lgbm_result = next(r for r in results if r["model"] == "lightgbm")
    mlflow.log_metric("val/roc_auc", lgbm_result["auc"])
    mlflow.log_metric("val/average_precision", lgbm_result["ap"])
    mlflow.log_metric("val/f1", lgbm_result["f1"])
    mlflow.log_metric("training_elapsed_s", lgbm_result["train_time_s"])

    # Log tags
    mlflow.set_tag("model_name", "lightgbm")
    mlflow.set_tag("git_branch", "feat/model-training")

    # Log model with signature
    sig = infer_signature(X_val_fe, model_lgbm.predict_proba(X_val_fe)[:, :1])
    model_info = mlflow.sklearn.log_model(
        model_lgbm,
        artifact_path="model",
        signature=sig,
        input_example=X_val_fe.iloc[:5],
    )

    run_id_lgbm = run.info.run_id
    print(f"  Run ID: {run_id_lgbm}")
    print(f"  Model URI: {model_info.model_uri}")

    # Register
    model_name_lgbm = "fraud-detection-lgbm"
    try:
        client.create_registered_model(model_name_lgbm, description="LightGBM binary classifier for IEEE-CIS fraud detection")
    except Exception:
        pass

    mv = client.create_model_version(
        name=model_name_lgbm,
        source=model_info.model_uri,
        run_id=run_id_lgbm,
        description=f"LightGBM baseline — AUC={lgbm_result['auc']:.4f}",
        tags={"framework": "lightgbm", "validation_auc": f"{lgbm_result['auc']:.4f}"},
    )
    client.set_registered_model_alias(model_name_lgbm, "champion", mv.version)

    print(f"  Registered: {model_name_lgbm} v{mv.version} (champion)")
```

# 8. Verify registry

```{python}
print("=== Model Registry ===\n")

for model_name in ["fraud-detection-lgbm", "fraud-detection-xgboost", "fraud-detection-rf"]:
    try:
        rm = client.get_registered_model(model_name)
        versions = client.search_model_versions(f"name='{model_name}'")
        champion = None
        for v in versions:
            if "champion" in (getattr(v, "aliases", []) or []):
                champion = v
                break
        print(f"{model_name}:")
        print(f"  Description: {rm.description}")
        print(f"  Versions: {len(versions)}")
        if champion:
            print(f"  Champion: v{champion.version} (run {champion.run_id[:8]})")
        print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{model_name}: NOT FOUND ({e})\n")
```

# 9. Verify DagsHub runs

```{python}
runs = mlflow.search_runs(experiment_ids=[experiment.experiment_id])
print(f"Total runs in '{experiment.name}': {len(runs)}\n")

# Show only our comparison runs
comparison_runs = runs[runs["tags.mlflow.runName"].isin([RUN_NAME_LGBM, RUN_NAME_XGB, RUN_NAME_RF])]
if len(comparison_runs) > 0:
    for _, row in comparison_runs.iterrows():
        run_name = row.get("tags.mlflow.runName", "N/A")
        auc = row.get("metrics.val/roc_auc", "N/A")
        ap = row.get("metrics.val/average_precision", "N/A")
        model = row.get("params.model_name", "N/A")
        print(f"  {run_name:30s}  model={model:15s}  AUC={auc}  AP={ap}")
else:
    print("  No comparison runs found (they may be under different run names)")
    print("  Check DagsHub manually: https://dagshub.com/alexmatiasas/fraud-detection-ml.mlflow")
```
